title: skills/objectstack-i18n: the fields.{field_name} row misses relatedListTitle, the bundle slot #29942 adds
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

Filing gate: ① a named-location defect, the `Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #29989 (#29942), the same move as #26759 was for PR #26757. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3.

Blocked-by: #29989

**Business reason.** Once PR #29989 lands, a bundle can translate a related list's title through `objects.<child>.fields.<field>.relatedListTitle`. An author or agent that learns the bundle shape from `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` will not find the slot, so the self-lookup case #29942 fixed (a zh-CN related list titled with the child object's label, 「合同」) gets reported again. Reader: the skills seat (`skills/**` is Tier H; the maintainer merges).

## What the skill says (at `origin/main`)

`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` ≈:162, the `fields.{field_name}` row: `label`, `help`, `placeholder`, `options`, `inlineTitle`. It has no `relatedListTitle`.

## Wanted

- Add `relatedListTitle` to that row: the title of the related list a `lookup` / `master_detail` field draws on its PARENT's record page. The field lives on the child object, so the key is the child's, and untranslated it keeps its authored text. Mirror the `inlineTitle` wording.
- Optionally extend the example at ≈:189 with one `relatedListTitle` entry.
- Pay for the added text within the `check-skills-token-ratchet` ceiling, by deleting text in the same file.

Serial: after PR #29989 merges.

Dedupe: searched `objectstack-i18n relatedListTitle` and `skills i18n fields row`. Found only #26759 (closed, the `inlineTitle` precedent). **New.**
